FN-V7MJYPP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 185
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/31/2025
House Bill 185 as introduced would appropriate for fiscal year 2025:
1) $100,000 from the Alabama Board of Public Accountancy Fund to the Alabama Board of
Public Accountancy;
2) $12,789,146 from the Court Automation Fund to the Unified Judicial System; and
3) $7,656,820 from the Advanced Technology and Data Exchange Fund to the Unified Judicial
System.
In addition, this bill amends Section 3 of Act 2024-355, the Fiscal Year 2025 General Fund
Appropriations Act, to increase funding for the repayment of bonds issued by the Alabama
Federal Aid Highway Finance Authority, the Alabama Highway Finance Corporation, or the
Alabama Industrial Access Road and Bridge Corporation by $13 million for a total of
$126,253,921.

FN-V7MJYPP-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 185
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/24/2025
House Bill 185 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund would
appropriate for fiscal year 2025:
1) $100,000 from the Alabama State Board of Public Accountancy Fund to the Alabama State
Board of Public Accountancy;
2) $8,017,325 from the Court Automation Fund to the Unified Judicial System;
3) $4,588,740 from the Advanced Technology and Data Exchange Fund to the Unified Judicial
System;
4) $2.0 million from the Alabama Recycling Fund to the Department of Environmental
Management;
5) $5.0 million from Departmental Receipts to the Department of Commerce; and
6) $50 million, estimated, from the American Rescue Plan Act - State Small Business Credit
Initiative Fund to the Department of Finance.
In addition, this bill amends Section 3C of Act 2024-355, the Fiscal Year 2025 General Fund
Appropriations Act, to increase funding for the repayment of bonds issued by the Alabama
Federal Aid Highway Finance Authority, the Alabama Highway Finance Corporation, or the
Alabama Industrial Access Road and Bridge Corporation by $13 million for a total of
$126,253,921.
